description: Multiplies a pitch by a whole number ratio, for setting the interval of an FM operator

params.text: Sets the ratio the pitch is multiplied by, 1 to 32 in whole steps
Adds a fraction to the ratio, -1 to 1; while the ratio is at 1 only positive fractions are used
While on, the pitch is divided by the ratio in place of being multiplied by it

inputs.text: The pitch to be multiplied, one per channel, read as 1V per octave
Sets the ratio by voltage in place of the knob, 3.2 ratios per volt; a negative voltage sets the same ratio and turns 1/x on
Sets the fraction by voltage in place of the Fine knob, a tenth of a ratio step per volt

outputs.text: The pitch with the ratio applied; the ratio is added as its base-two logarithm, so a ratio of 2 raises the pitch by an octave

notes: the Ratio and Fine jacks are read once every 32 samples, and while either is patched it moves its knob

inputs.1:
±10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Ratio knob.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Fine knob.
